{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma2
|version1= 1.00

|game2= arma2oa
|version2= 1.50

|game3= tkoh
|version3= 1.00

|game4= arma3
|version4= 0.50

|gr1= Camera Control

|descr= Returns mode of active camera view. Mode is one of: 
* "INTERNAL" (1st person)
* "EXTERNAL" (3rd person)
* "GUNNER" (optics / sights)
* "GROUP" (commander view)

|s1= [[cameraView]]

|r1= [[String]]

|x1= <sqf>
if (cameraOn == _vehicle && cameraView == "EXTERNAL") then
{
	_vehicle switchCamera "INTERNAL";
};
</sqf>

|seealso= [[switchCamera]] [[cameraOn]] [[cameraEffect]]
}}
